title: pikku-inspect --stdin output
description: What `pikku-inspect --stdin` writes to stdout on success (exit code 0). Mirrors InspectorGoOutput in src/protocol.ts. stderr is free-form and passed through to the user.

protocol.description: Protocol version. The wrapper rejects any other.

finalized.description: True when the binary already ran finalize; the wrapper then skips the TypeScript finalize. False while finalize is TypeScript-only.

state.description: A SerializableInspectorState (packages/inspector/src/utils/serialize-inspector-state.ts), read with deserializeInspectorState. Pre-finalize when `finalized` is false. Sections the engine does not produce yet may be absent; the parity harness reports them as not ported.

diagnostics.description: Every message the TypeScript engine would have sent to its logger, in order. Replayed into the CLI logger.

files.description: Source files in the program, node_modules and lib included.

projectFiles.description: Files under rootDir the inspector swept.

code.description: An ErrorCode value, e.g. PKU123. A coded error or warn becomes a tracked diagnostic.
